delivery.commit_subject: BP5-SVC-016: package honest service stack topology

handoffs.message: Helper-claimed by Codex while Claude completes higher-priority work.

Honest compose stack packaged. Added service Dockerfiles, compose-backed smoke profile, remote VM runbook updates, and cross-process IncidentStore refresh so incidents/postmortems share file-backed state. Verified with 'docker compose --profile smoke up --build --abort-on-container-exit smoke-stack' passing end to end.
Review approved: honest compose stack meets both acceptance criteria. All six surfaces boot via one topology; smoke script proves no local-only fallbacks.
